card.name: Noun after enzyme or drug name
card.fires_on: A noun such as activity, inhibitor, inhibition or toxicity right after a CYP enzyme name or a drug name. It also fires on a few other nouns that end a technical term, like grading or prophylaxis.

modes.label: After CYP enzyme names
modes.description: The noun activity, inhibitor or inhibition follows a CYP enzyme name in an interaction statement.
modes.example: inhibitor of CYP3A4<< activity>>, to be at least 10

modes.label: After drug or scale names
modes.description: A noun such as toxicity or grading follows a drug name or a scale name.
modes.example: 7.5 Lithium Lithium<< toxicity>> has been reported in patients receiving lithium con

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mixed set with no clear link, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks the word that names an enzyme effect, such as activity or inhibitor, right after an enzyme or drug name.
